[SWS_CM_10297] Conditions for sending of a SOME/IP request message
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00006,
RS_SOMEIP_00007
⌈
The sending of a SOME/IP request message shall be requested by invoking the
operator()
of the respective
Method
class (see [SWS_CM_00196]) if there is
static service connection according to [SWS_CM_02201] or if the providing service
instance has not stopped offering the service (either because the
TTL
contained in the
SOME/IP
OfferService
message (see [SWS_CM_00203]) has expired or because
the
StopOfferService()
method (see [SWS_CM_00111]) of the
ServiceSkele-
ton
class has been called).
⌋
